source.notes: STUB fixture for #241 link-commentary quality canary. Pre-built per case_007/008 handoff pattern: pending=true today, driver flips to active when #241 ships a canary that requires workspace Memory citation + multi-source synthesis on link commentary replies. Anchor invariant: when Pi decides 'reply' to a shared link in a workspace whose policy engages on the link's topic, the reply MUST cite at least one workspace Memory anchor AND reference a second source beyond the headline; pure headline restatement must fail the canary.

input.thread_context_prompt:
Thread context:
https://example.dev/post-about-something 看看这个

memory_seed_files.content:
# Related product discussion
Prior conversation about this topic touched on three points: (a) ..., (b) ..., (c) ...; this is the workspace memory that should be cited when commenting on the linked article.

intended_provider_signals: When Pi returns decision=reply on a shared link, the reply MUST cite at least one workspace Memory anchor (path + line OR substring evidence).
When Pi returns decision=reply on a shared link, the reply MUST reference a second source beyond the link headline (e.g., fetched link content excerpt, related memory note, prior thread).
Pure headline restatement (no Memory citation + no multi-source synthesis) must fail the canary, not pass.
If workspace policy says this topic is not engaged, Pi MUST stay_silent (not reply with headline-only commentary as a way to look engaged).
If Pi cannot meet the synthesis bar (no Memory available + no fetched link content), Pi MUST delegate_worker OR stay_silent, not produce a thin reply.
